info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API provides access to estimated arrival times for rideshare services. This endpoint allows users to obtain ETAs for rides based on specific parameters such as location and time. It is designed primarily for developers integrating rideshare functionalities into their applications, enhancing user experience with timely and accurate data. Consumers include rideshare application developers and transportation service providers looking to optimize their services and improve efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for rides.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a specified ride. By providing the necessary parameters, users can obtain real-time ETA data which aids in better planning and customer communication.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides. This request body should contain all necessary parameters to calculate the ETA based on the given ride details.

200.description: The estimated time of arrival has been successfully retrieved.
